# Typing Buddy

> The offline, privacy-first typing assistant and autocomplete for Windows.

## Project Summary
Typing Buddy is an open-source Windows desktop utility that provides instant word completions, fuzzy spelling corrections, abbreviation snippets, and real-time offline grammar suggestions as users type across any Windows application. It runs 100% locally on the CPU with zero network code, no telemetry, and volatile RAM-only sentence tracking.

## Core Capabilities
- **Trie-Based Autocomplete:** Sub-millisecond unigram and bigram word completions from bundled offline word packs (`wordpacks/en-basic`, `wordpacks/en-large`, `wordpacks/hinglish`).
- **Fuzzy Typo Correction:** Damerau-Levenshtein distance algorithm with QWERTY keyboard physical adjacency weights.
- **Offline Grammar Checking:** Integrated Harper engine (`harper-py`) allow-listing syntactic rules (subject-verb agreement, confusing word choices, repeated words) while strictly suppressing spelling lints.
- **Strict Privacy Architecture:** No internet access, no analytics, no persistent sentence logging. Rolling sentence buffer (`TextTracker`) is capped at 300 characters in RAM and erased on cursor movement or window changes.
- **Password Field Protection:** Automatically detects Windows UI Automation (UIA) password fields and process blocklists, putting the tool into an auto-paused state.
- **Windows Integration:** Native desktop shortcuts, Windows Start search support, system tray indicator with status colors (Green/Orange/Grey), and single-instance mutex.

## Target Audience
Windows 10 and 11 users seeking fast, system-wide typing completions and grammar feedback without sacrificing personal privacy, sending keystrokes to cloud servers, or paying subscriptions.

## Quick Installation
Requires Windows 10/11 and Python >= 3.10:
```cmd
git clone https://github.com/harshverse-svg/typing-buddy.git
cd typing-buddy
install.bat
```
Run `start.bat` to launch in the background.

## Key Files & Structure
- `typing_buddy/app.py`: Main runtime, event hooks, threading pipelines, and GUI overlays.
- `typing_buddy/data_dir.py`: User data folder isolation (`%APPDATA%\typing-buddy\`) and safe one-time migrations.
- `typing_buddy/predictor.py`: Word lookup, trie caching, and unigram/bigram frequency ranking.
- `typing_buddy/fuzzy.py`: Damerau-Levenshtein typo correction engine.
- `typing_buddy/grammar/`: Offline sentence-level grammar linting via Harper adapter.
- `typing_buddy/tray.py`: Dynamic notification area icon and configuration menu.
- `typing_buddy/winapi.py`: Low-level Windows API wrappers (UIA password checks, caret coordinates, startup shortcuts).
- `tools/check_no_network.py`: AST parser verifying complete absence of network libraries.
- `tools/check_no_personal_data.py`: Pre-commit/CI validator preventing sensitive file leakage.

## Technical Specifications
- Language: Python 3.10+
- Platform: Microsoft Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
- Dependencies: `pynput`, `pystray`, `Pillow`, `comtypes`, `harper-py` (optional)
